<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Felipe Marques Conselheiro</title>
<meta name="description" content="Felipe Marques, Conselheiro em Dependência Química. Conteúdos sobre dependência química e emocional, e o livro Para Além do Vício.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lora:ital,wght@0,500;0,700;1,500&family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --creme:#F6F0E2; --creme-2:#EFE6D1; --dourado:#B08A34; --dourado-2:#8E6E25;
  --verde:#1F3D2B; --verde-2:#2E5640; --rosa:#D77A8E; --rosa-2:#ECA9B6;
  --texto:#1F3D2B; --suave:#5B6B5F; --branco:#FFFDF8;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--creme);color:var(--texto);font-family:Poppins,system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:300;line-height:1.65;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
a{color:inherit}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:Lora,Georgia,serif;font-weight:700;line-height:1.15;color:var(--verde)}
.ouro{color:var(--dourado)}
.divisor{width:72px;height:3px;background:var(--dourado);border-radius:2px;margin:18px auto}
.eyebrow{font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dourado);font-weight:500}

/* topo */
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:rgba(246,240,226,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(176,138,52,.35)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:64px}
.marca{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none}
.marca svg{width:34px;height:auto}
.marca b{font-family:Lora,serif;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--verde)}
.menu{display:flex;gap:22px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:400}
.menu a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--verde)}
.menu a:hover{color:var(--dourado)}
@media(max-width:720px){.menu{display:none}}

/* botões */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:500;font-size:.95rem;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .15s,background .15s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-verde{background:var(--verde);color:var(--creme)}
.btn-verde:hover{background:var(--verde-2)}
.btn-ouro{background:var(--dourado);color:var(--branco)}
